# Resource: tfe_agent_pool_allowed_projects

Adds and removes allowed projects on an agent pool.

~> **Note:** This resource requires using the provider with HCP Terraform and a HCP Terraform for Business tier plan. [Learn more about HCP Terraform pricing here](https://www.hashicorp.com/products/terraform/pricing).

## Example Usage

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.organization.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.project.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.agentPool.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.agentPoolAllowedProjects.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        Organization tfeOrganizationTestOrganization = new Organization(this, "test-organization", new OrganizationConfig()
                .email("admin@company.com")
                .name("my-org-name")
                );
        Project tfeProjectTestProject = new Project(this, "test-project", new ProjectConfig()
                .name("my-project-name")
                .organization(Token.asString(tfeOrganizationTestOrganization.getName()))
                );
        AgentPool tfeAgentPoolTestAgentPool = new AgentPool(this, "test-agent-pool", new AgentPoolConfig()
                .name("my-agent-pool-name")
                .organization(Token.asString(tfeOrganizationTestOrganization.getName()))
                .organizationScoped(false)
                );
        new AgentPoolAllowedProjects(this, "allowed", new AgentPoolAllowedProjectsConfig()
                .agentPoolId(Token.asString(tfeAgentPoolTestAgentPool.getId()))
                .allowedProjectIds(List.of(Token.asString(tfeProjectTestProject.getId())))
                );
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agentPoolId` (String) The ID of the agent pool.
- `allowedProjectIds` (Set of String) IDs of projects to be added as allowed projects on the agent pool.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource. Do not rely on this value — use `agentPoolId` instead.



## Import

Resource tfe_agent_pool_allowed_projects can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <AGENT POOL ID>
terraform import tfe_agent_pool_allowed_projects.foobar apool-rW0KoLSlnuNb5adB
```
